overall_reason: Two large blurred colour blobs float on a 6 s infinite loop behind the hero, style cards zoom their preview image over 500 ms and fade in an overlay on hover, and the controls run on a mix of browser ease ("transition: all" at 300 ms on 35 elements) and Tailwind defaults; the style filters ("SaaS", "All", "Light") change instantly, which is right.

score.reason: T-LOOPS finds a decorative float loop, T-HOVER-SIGNAL finds an image zoom plus overlay on every card, and T-MOTION-SYSTEM finds two default curve families with "all" transitions.

findings.title: Loops show a state or real data
findings.where: hero background, two .animate-float blobs (384 x 384 and 320 x 320 px), 1440
findings.evidence: Running animations at 1440 include "float 6s ease-in-out infinite" on two blurred gradient blobs behind the heading; the theme ships it as a token (--animate-float). The live run of the theme toggle counted 2 ambient movers before the click.
findings.before: Two colour blobs float behind the hero on a 6 s loop.
findings.why: The loop shows no state or data and keeps the area behind the headline moving.

findings.title: Hover answers with one small signal
findings.where: style cards in the "Styles" grid (trigger t2, card 429 x 241 px), 1440
findings.evidence: On contact-sheet row t2 the preview image zooms and a dark overlay with "View Demo" and "Show Prompt" fades in; the motion table measures opacity at 300 ms and scale at 500 ms on cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), and the stylesheet declares ".group-hover:scale-105" and ".group-hover:scale-110". The sweep records a MOT-002 duration hit of 370 ms.
findings.before: Each card zooms its image for 500 ms and fades in an overlay on hover.
findings.after: Keep the overlay with its two actions at about 150 ms and drop the image zoom.
findings.why: A slow image zoom on every card in a long grid is the stock hover; visitors scanning the grid trigger it on every card they pass.

findings.title: One curve family and one duration scale
findings.evidence: 71 elements use Tailwind's cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) and 37 use the browser default ease, across durations of 150, 200, 300 and 500 ms. 35 elements declare "transition: all 300ms ease" and the sweep's MOT-001 hit records "transition: all" on 64 elements.
findings.before: Two default curve families and four durations, with "all" on dozens of elements.
findings.after: Name one curve and two or three duration steps as tokens and transition named properties.
findings.why: The page's feedback timing is inherited from defaults, and "all" animates layout changes by accident.
findings.root: Tailwind utilities and an "all 300ms ease" component rule

strengths: The category and mode filters ("SaaS", "All", "Light") update the grid instantly, with no stagger on filtering.
not_investigated: "Toggle theme": the sweep's 1435 ms live duration hit is not judged here; the frames show no visible change in the toggle, and the 2 ambient movers (the float blobs) may account for it
reduced-motion runs for "All Modes", "Light", "SaaS" and "All" were skipped (time budget)
"Load More": the live run counted 125 ambient movers (animated style previews in the grid); not separable from the button's own motion
no 00-contract.md in the run: visitor mode inferred from the screenshots
no passive recording (capture.mjs --passive not run): load motion and loops judged from declared animations only, not from frames
interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built
scroll-driven and scroll-revealed motion beyond the load: the capture does not scroll while recording
hover as it plays: only the declared transitions are read
route and page transitions: not captured
T-POSTER and T-DEMO-LOOP: no demo animation or looping demo on the page
